newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt bank, IFC to provide risk management service.
newsitem.headline: Egypt bank, IFC to provide risk management service.

text.p: The International Finance Corporation (IFC) and the state-owned National Bank of Egypt have set up their first risk management facility for the private sector, IFC executive vice president said on Wednesday.

Jannik Lindbaek told a news conference in Cairo the bank had $400 million to use for a handful of risk management transactions like medium and long term financing at fixed interest rates and provide currency swaps against the dollar.

"Risk management facilities are not usually available in emerging markets because they require a certain level of creditworthiness. But we are confident in the private sector's role and its growth," Lindbaek said.
He did not give any details and bank officials were unavailable to comment.
